svg.aria-label: High level architecture. Sources: catalogue.csv, client.yaml, the Open Prices API for 9 grocery stores and the pages of 2 web shops. Data warehouse in PostgreSQL 17: 5 tables keep every price ever seen (prices inserted only, never updated or deleted, listings matched by barcode or name, 3 CHECK constraints, 7 tests); 4 views find one price per listing per day, each change, the latest gap and the undercuts (15 report checks). Consume: a Power BI report with 2 pages (Power Query, a model of 3 facts and 3 dimensions, 13 DAX measures), analysis.ipynb and the alert email. Apache Airflow 3 runs the competitor_prices DAG every Sunday, in Docker Compose.
svg.title: Competitor price tracker architecture

g.text: • one price per listing per day
Apache Airflow 3 runs the pipeline every Sunday
DAG competitor_prices: load_reference > collect_open_prices and collect_web_shops > match > send_alert
latest_only: the web shops are read and the email is sent on the latest week only (pages show today's price)
Docker Compose runs two containers: PostgreSQL 17 (the warehouse) and Airflow; the repo is mounted into Airflow
